rules.logic: ABIOC(Connected-App OAuth Token Mass-Export Deviation Triggering Auto-Revoke) AND XQL(Salesforce Query-Job Deletion Anti-Forensics by Exfiltration Token) AND XQL(SOAR Playbook OAuth Access and Refresh Token Revocation for Connected App) AND XQL(Revoked-Token Replay Returns 401 invalid_token Closed-Loop Proof) observed on the same connected_app and oauth_token_id within the run window — stitches the full closed loop trusted-token -> mass CRM export -> query-job deletion -> automated access+refresh token revocation -> revoked-token replay rejected 401 invalid_token into a SINGLE post-consent OAuth-token-abuse incident. The incident's terminal assertion is that the XSOAR auto-revoke playbook FIRED and CLOSED: the token that ran the export is verifiably dead because the subsequent replay returns 401 invalid_token, satisfying the F5 closed-loop response KPI. Forced re-authentication for affected admins is attached as corroborating remediation evidence; a benign Connected App whose token was NOT revoked is the blast-radius negative control.
rules.name: Connected-App OAuth Token Abuse Auto-Revoke Closed-Loop Stitch
